title: Single-cell multi-omic profiling allows the dissection of peripheral immune phenotypes in Alzheimer’s Disease progression

evidence_spans.quote: Here, we employed three high-resolution single-cell techniques
to investigate peripheral immunity in AD dementia
in contrast to healthy aging across cohorts

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: Primary human immune analysis explicitly contrasts AD progression with healthy aging and reports multi-omic profiling.

causal_design_reviewer.outcome: low-grade inflammation phenotype in classical monocytes

evidence_spans.quote: acquiring a NF- k B/AP-1-mediated low-grade inflammation phenotype

causal_design_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The abstract reports profiling and does not state an applied causal design or effect contrast; retention is based on the current-report mechanistic wording.
causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The abstract attributes a monocyte inflammation phenotype to NF-κB/AP-1 mediation in a completed current-report result.
